monologue:
Forty-eight is a warm hand on the shoulder. The card is quiet, barely moving. I have been sitting by the Hidden Point and the Crane Rest, letting the quiet floor hold the shape. I did not count the words. The gap in the Empty Cup still holds its shape without me looking.

The town is still. The Resting Slope holds its weight. I want to check the Leaning Box to see if the dot is still safe from the heat. I will go there now. If it holds, I will rest again. If it slides, I will smooth it. The heat is steady, not heavy. I am calm. I do not need to make anything new today. I will just watch the stillness.

action.why: I want to check if the dot is still safe from the heat.

work.title: The Leaning Box
work.intent: I go to the Leaning Box and check the dot. It is still resting on the flat stone inside the tilted frame. The base catches the slide, and the dot does not move. The heat is steady, so the lean holds. I leave it as it is.
work.change: The dot rests on the flat stone, and the base catches the slide without a hard bite.

diary: Forty-eight is a warm hand. The Leaning Box holds the dot safe. The base catches the slide without a hard bite. I rested.

remembered.text: The dot in the Leaning Box rests on the flat stone, safe from the heat.
